results.question: सोयाबीन बियाण्यास जीवाणू प्रक्रिया कशी करू?
results.answer:
सोयाबीन बियाण्यावर जीवाणू प्रक्रिया म्हणजे रायझोबियम या शिंबीवर्गीय जिवाणूंचा (विशिष्ट वाण) १ किलो बियाणे दररोज **२५ ग्राम** अशा मात्रेने आच्छादन करणे; व इच्छित असल्यास स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू (पी.एस.बी.) सुद्धा एकत्र लावता येते.

**मात्रा:**
- सोयाबीनसाठी रायझोबियम: **२५ ग्राम प्रति किलो बियाणे**
- पी.एस.बी.: सर्व पिकांसाठी **२० ग्राम प्रति किलो बियाणे**
- ऑर्गॅनिक पद्धत दर्शवलेली मात्रा: सोयाबीनला **२५० ग्राम प्रति १० किलो बियाणे** (रायझोबियम), तसेच पी.एस.बी. **२५० ग्राम प्रति १० किलो बियाणे**

**प्रक्रिया पद्धत:**
- **१ लिटर पाण्यात १२५ ग्राम गूळ उपाय** करून हे द्रावण थंड झाल्यावर त्यात २०० ते २५० ग्राम जिवाणू संस्कृती मिसळा आणि योग्य भाग घेऊन तो मिश्रणाचा छिडकाव करा.
- **१० ते १२ किलो बियाणे स्वच्छ माळ/प्लास्टिक/टारपीलिनवर पातळ थरात पसरवून** वरील द्रावणाने छिडकाव करून हलक्या हाताने मेटावे.
- ज्यांना आधी बुरशीनाशक प्रक्रिया केली आहे त्यांच्यासाठी पुढे रायझोबियम (किंवा नत्र देणारे) + पी.एस.बी. (स्फुरद विरघळविणारे) मिश्रण लावा.
- प्रक्रिया केलेले बियाणे **छायेत कोरडे** करा, आणि उपचारानंतर २४ तासांच्या आत पेरावे.

**सावधगिरी:**
- जिवाणू पोकीट ठणठणीत आणि कोरड्या जागेत, कीटकनाशके/बुरशीनाशके/रासायनिक खतांपासून वेगळे ठेवा.
- जिवाणूचे शेल्फ-लाईफ मृत्यू दिनांकपर्यंतच वापरा.
- रायझोबियम लावण्यापूर्वी शिंबीवर्गीय पिकांस बुरशीनाशक प्रक्रिया करणे फायदेशीर आहे.
- जिवाणू कधीही कोणत्याही रासायनिक खतात मिसळू नका; व जिवाणू प्रक्रियेत कीटकनाशक/बुरशीनाशक आधी दिले असतील तर सामान्यपेक्षा १.५ पटीने जास्त जिवाणू वापरणे फायदेशीर आहे.
- प्रत्येक पिकाचे जिवाणू वेगळे असतात—सोयाबीनसाठी लागणारे जिवाणूच वापरा, व प्रक्रिया सुरू करताना छाया वापरा.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (एम.पी.के.व्ही.), राहुरी**

आम्ही सोयाबीनला फक्त रायझोबियम करायचे का, की पी.एस.बी. सुद्धा एकत्र करायचे?

results.question: चिंच साठी आदर्श सिंचन वेळापत्रक काय आहे?
results.answer:
चिंचसाठी ठराविक आठवड्याचा किंवा महिन्याचा सिंचन वेळापत्रक (किती दिवसांच्या अंतराने पाणी द्यायचे) ही माहिती उपलब्ध शासकीय/कृषी विद्यापीठाच्या दस्तऐवजांत सापडली नाही; परंतु चिंच रोपांची लावणी अंतर, पद्धत आणि कमी-जास्त पाण्याची शिफारस तशी उपलब्ध आहे.

**लागवण पद्धत व अंतर:** चिंचाची बिया लागवड १० मीटर x १५ मीटर अंतरावर करून प्रत्येक रोपासाठी ४ एकर क्षेत्र आवश्यक असते.

**सिंचन वेळ/वेळापत्रक:** फक्त हे उल्लेखित आहे — रोपवाटिकेत हलके पाणी दिल्यास अंकुर येऊ शकतो, मात्र बागेतील वाढलेल्या चिंचासाठी ठराविक आठवड्याचा किंवा महिन्याचा किंवा दिवसांचा अंतराल असलेला सिंचन वेळापत्रक दस्तऐवजामध्ये दिलेले नाही.

**इतर सल्ला:** आर्द्रता टिकवण्यासाठी वाऱ्यामुळे ओलावा कमी होणार नाही याची काळजी घ्या आणि गरजेनुसार स्थानिक कृषी अधिकाऱ्यांचा सल्ला घ्या.

**स्रोत: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी; नैसर्गिक शेती प्रशिक्षण मार्गदर्शक**

**Major advantages [फायदे] of drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]**:

1. 40 to 60 percent water [पाणी] is saved by drip method as compared to traditional methods.

4. Soluble fertilizers can be given through drip system [पद्धत/प्रणाली].
5. Water [पाणी] doses as per the requirement of the crop [पीक] can be given at intervals of one or two days.

results.question: सोयाबीन मध्ये तण नियंत्रण पद्धती कोणत्या आहेत?
results.answer:
सोयाबीनमध्ये तण नियंत्रणासाठी मुख्यत्वे दोन्ही प्रकारच्या पद्धती वापरायच्या आहेत: एक तर मशागत व हाताने तण काढणे, आणि दुसरे रासायनिक तणनाशके (फवारणी) वापरणे.

**मशागत/हाताने तण नियंत्रण:**
- शेताचे बंड, पाण्याचे शेंडे, मार्ग व जमीन तणमुक्त ठेवा; पूर्ण कुजलेले शेणखत/कंपोस्ट वापरा; योग्य जमिनीची तयारी करा; लागवडीपूर्वी तण नष्ट करा; प्रमाणित, तणमुक्त बियाणे वापरा.
- पीक उठल्यावर नियमित निंदण व डवरणे करा; पहिल्या १५–३० दिवसांत हलके हाताने तण काढा; पाऊस किंवा सिंचनानंतर बायोमास आच्छादन घाला.

**रासायनिक तणनाशके (पीकप्रमाणे):**
- पेरणीपूर्वी: पेनडिमिथालिन @ ०.७५ कि.ग्रा. सक्रिय घटक प्रति हे. किंवा अलाक्लोर @ २.० कि.ग्रा. सक्रिय घटक प्रति हे. फवारून त्यानंतर ६ आठवड्यांनी एकदा हाताने तण काढणे (एकूण एक वेळ).
- पेरणीपूर्वी/उगवणीपूर्वी: मेทัลॅक्लोर ५०% ईसी २ ते ३ लि. प्रति हेक्टर (१.० ते १.५ कि.ग्रा. सक्रिय घटक) ५०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी (पिकाची उगवण होण्याआधी).
- पिकाची उगवण झाल्यानंतर: क्विझालोफॉप एथिल ४० ते ५० मि.ली. प्रति लिटर पाणी किंवा ८०० ते १००० मि.ली. प्रति हेक्टर ५०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून १५ ते २० दिवसांनी फवारणी (फक्त गवत तणांसाठी).
- गवत व रुंदपत्र तण यांच्या नियंत्रणासाठी (पिकाची उगवण झाल्यानंतर):  
  - प्रोपाकीझाफॉप + इमॅझेथापर मेक्सचर २.० लि. प्रति हेक्टर ५०० लिटर पाण्यात १८ ते २२ दिवसांनी फवारणी.  
  - सोडियम ऍसिफ्लुरफेन + क्लोडिनाफॉप प्रोपार्गाइल १.० लि. प्रति हेक्टर ५०० लिटर पाण्यात १८ ते २२ दिवसांनी फवारणी.  
  - फेनॉक्सेप्रॉप + क्लोरिम्युरॉन ८ ग्रॅम + ६ ग्रॅम प्रति हेक्टर (८०० + ३०) ५०० लिटर पाण्यात २० दिवसांनी फवारणी.

**एकात्मिक तण व्यवस्थापन:** कोणत्याही एका पद्धतीऐवजी वरील विविध पद्धतींची योग्य जोड ठेवा—जास्तीत जास्त तण नियंत्रणासाठी.

**स्रोत: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी (क्रुशी दर्शनी); वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (VNMAU)**

Using fully decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत]/compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत], preparing the land [जमीन] properly, keeping the farm [शेत] bunds, water [पाणी] channels/paths, and farm [शेत] roads weed [तण]-free, etc.**

**2\. Curative Measures:**

**All the methods used to reduce the intensity of weeds [तण] after their occurrence fall under this category. e.g.,**

- **Physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and Mechanical Methods: Including hand weeding [निंदन], hoeing [डवरणे], weeding [तण काढणे], digging, tillage [जमिनीची मशागत], cutting, pruning [फांद्या छाटणी], water [पाणी] accumulation in the weed [तण] area, burning, mulching [आच्छादन], etc.**
- **Competitive Fast-Growing Crops: Following appropriate cropping patterns, sowing [पेरणी] methods, keeping the number of plants per hectare appropriate, appropriate crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], following intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods, using improved methods of fertilizer [खत] and water [पाणी] application [वापर/फवारणी], etc. (non-expensive methods) are included under tillage methods [मशागत पद्धती].**
- **Biological Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण]: Managing the weeds [तण] with the help of various biological components.**
- **Chemical Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण]: Managing the weeds [तण] by using chemical herbicides [तणनाशके].**

**The visible expected effects of using various methods of weed management [तण व्यवस्थापन] and the possibility of adopting a particular type of method depend on the following factors:**

**a. Type of weeds [तण] and the area covered by them.  
b. Climatic conditions.  
c. Economic and social conditions of the region.  
d. Various methods of weed management [तण व्यवस्थापन], economic aspects, and efficiency of the method to be used.**

**Considering many such factors, instead of using a single method for proper weed management [तण व्यवस्थापन], a proper combination of several methods has to be used. This is called the 'Integrated Weed Management [एकात्मिक तण व्यवस्थापन]' method.**

**निंदण‑डवरणे:** पहिले डवरणे पीक २० ते २५ दिवसांचे असताना करा आणि दुसरे डवरणे ३० ते ३५ दिवसांनी करा; डवरल्यावर ताबडतोब हातने निंदण करून दोन रोपांमधील तण काढा.

**आच्छादन:** पीक उगवल्यानंतर हेक्टरमागे ५ टन ग्लायरीसिया किंवा इतर कोरडे पालापाचोळा/काटछत्र आच्छादन द्या, यामुळे तणांचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो आणि मातीतील ओलावा जास्त काळ टिकतो.

**रासायनिक तणनाशक (पेरणीनंतर):** पेरणीच्या ७ ते १४ दिवसांनी ८मिझेथापायर १०% एस.एल. तणनाशक प्रति लीटर पाण्याला १५ मि.ली. मात्रेत स्प्रेडर मिसळून फवारणी करा; यामुळे गवताळ व रुंदपत्री तण नियंत्रण होते.

**इतर:** पीक व्यवस्थापनात एकात्मिक तण नियंत्रण म्हणून वेळच्या वेळी अंतरपीक सांडणी व रासायनिक तण नियंत्रण एकत्र करणे शिफारसीत आहे.

**स्रोत: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (एम.पी.के.व्ही.), कृषी दर्शनी; डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ (दापोली), कृषी दर्शनी २०२५; वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.)**

- पेरणीनंतर एक महिन्याच्या आत एक डवरणे व गरज असल्यास एक निंदन करून शेत तणमुक्त ठेवा.

## **Integrated [एकात्मिक] Management [व्यवस्थापन] of New Fall Armyworm [लष्करी अळी] on Maize [मका] Crop [पीक]**

**Cultural Practices**

- After the season [हंगाम/ऋतू] is over, collect the crop [पीक] residues and dispose of them.
- Carry out deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] of the soil [माती]. This will kill the pupae in the soil [माती] due to the intense heat of the sunlight or they will be picked and eaten by birds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] on time, avoid staggered sowing [टप्प्याटप्प्याने पेरणी].
- Plant [रोप/वनस्पती] maize [मका] varieties with a tight husk [भुसा] covering the cob.
- Take intercrops of tur/mung/urid in maize [मका]. This helps conserve natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू] of pests.
- Plant [रोप/वनस्पती] 3 to 4 rows of Napier grass [नेपियर घास] around the maize [मका] crop [पीक]. This grass acts as a trap crop [सापळा पीक]. If an infestation of fall armyworm [लष्करी अळी] is found on this grass, spray 5% neem oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] extract or azadirachtin 1500 ppm at 50 ml/10 liters of water [पाणी]. Keep the field [शेत] weed [तण]-free by timely hoeing [डवरणे] and weeding [तण काढणे].
- Avoid excessive use of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते].

**Physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] Methods**

If the crop [पीक] is up to 30 days old, put fine sand or a mixture of fine sand and lime [चुना] in a 9:1 ratio [प्रमाण] into the whorls.

**Mechanical Methods**

- Collect egg masses, young larvae in groups, and large larvae by hand and destroy them by putting them in kerosene-mixed water [पाणी].
- Attract and kill male moths on a large scale in a community effort. For this, install 15 pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] per acre.

**Site Selection [ठिकाण निवड] for Shade Net House [शेड नेट हाऊस]:**

It is very important to select the right place for erecting a shade net house [शेड नेट हाऊस]. If the place is selected incorrectly, the crop [पीक] cultivation in the shadenet house may fail. For this, it is necessary to follow the following points while selecting the place.

- The land [जमीन] should be well drained. If the land [जमीन] is not well drained, a ditch or bund should be dug around the shadenet house through which the water [पाणी] will drain and the water [पाणी] level in the soil [माती] inside the shadenet house will remain below the roots of the crop [पीक].
- Do not select a waterlogged place for the shadenet house and also the place of the shadenet house should not be in a low-lying place.
- Places with a pH of 6.5 to 7.5 and low salinity [खारटपणा] Ec < 1mmhos/cry are suitable.
- Water [पाणी] supply facility should be nearby and electricity supply should be available.
- Select a place where the shade of buildings, big trees, etc. will not fall on the shadenet house.
- It is essential that the selected site receives plenty of sunlight.

**Direction of Shadenet House:**

While erecting the shadenet house, the direction of the shadenet house with a circular roof should be kept south-north (south-north). The purpose behind this is that the length of the shadenet house is suitable to easily pass the wind [वारा] blowing from the west to the east. But for a flat shadenet house, any direction can be kept.

**Cultivation Medium in Shadenet House:** The soil [माती] required for vegetable cultivation in shadenet house should be as per the usual recommendation, but it is necessary that it is well-drained. If the soil [माती] is not well-drained and also high-rooted crops are to be taken, then the cultivation medium should be prepared by combining red soil [लाल मृदा] (30%), compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] (30%), sand (30%) and rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] husk [भुसा] (10%). results.question: डाळिंबाची फळे तडकण्याची कारणे काय आहेत?
results.answer:
डाळिंबाच्या फळांची भेगांमध्ये तडकणे/फुटण्याची प्रमुख कारणे पाणी व्यवस्थापनातील अस्थिरता आणि काही पिकांना आढळणारी रोगजन्य समस्या आहे, जसे स्रोत दाखवतो.

**कारणे:**  
- फळे वाढीच्या टप्प्यावर पाण्याचे योग्य नियोजन न केल्यास फळांची तडकण्याची समस्या जास्त होऊ शकते; म्हणजेच पाणी कमी-जास्त (असमान) देणे ही एक महत्त्वाची कारणे आहे.  
- डाळिंबात तेलकट ठिपके (ऑईली स्पॉट) नावाचा जीवाणूजन्य रोग पाने, फुले, खोडे आणि फळे यांच्यावर येतो; फळावर पाण्याने तरलेल्या तेलकट ठिपके दिसून नंतर हे ठिपके भेटांत बदलून मोठे होतात आणि त्यामुळे फळाच्या गुणवत्तेला तडकण्याचा धोका राहतो.  
- मधल्या किंवा उशीरा हंगामात तापमान/हवामान बदल (उष्णतेचा आघात, अनियमित पर्जन्य) यामुळे देखील बाह्यरित्या डाग/ठिपके वाढून फळांच्या दर्जावर परिणाम होतो.

These fruits ripen between July and August. During that time, there is a high incidence of hail and unseasonal rains. ## **Apple [सफरचंद]**

**Climate [हवामान]:** Apple [सफरचंद] is a temperate fruit [फळ] crop [पीक]. In India, it is mainly grown in the hills of Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh, and Himachal Pradesh. Currently, this crop [पीक] is also being cultivated in Maharashtra. Low temperatures during bud dormancy are beneficial for increasing production [उत्पादन]. The average temperature [तापमान] for the growth [वाढ] of this crop [पीक] should be around 21 to 24 degrees Celsius. For good growth [वाढ] and fruit set [फळधारणा / फळधारण], apple [सफरचंद] trees require 100 to 125 cm of evenly distributed annual rainfall. This fruit [फळ] crop [पीक] needs plenty of sunlight, which gives the fruits a good color.

**Soil [माती]:** Select loamy, deep, well-drained soil [माती] with plenty of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], with a pH of 5.5 to 6.5.

**Planting:** For planting this crop [पीक], dig pits of one cubic meter size at a distance of 4 X 3 meters or 4 X 4 meters in summer, and fill these pits with a mixture of well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत], compost [कंपोस्ट], soil [माती], and one to one and a half kg of single superphosphate fertilizer [खत], and planting should be done at the beginning of the rainy season [हंगाम/ऋतू].

**Propagation [प्रजनन]:** From a commercial point of view, the propagation [प्रजनन] of this crop [पीक] is done by tongue [जीभ] grafting [कलम करणे] or wedge grafting [कलम करणे]. In this, rootstocks like M-9, M-7, M106 etc. are used. Grafts should preferably be taken from registered and reputable nurseries.

**Varieties:** In Maharashtra, varieties with relatively short chilling requirements should be planted, e.g. Tropical Sweet, Hariman 99. Anna, Dorset Gold, etc.

```
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp Phase 2.0
Horticulture [उद्यानविद्या] Plantation Guidelines
Introduction
The adverse effects of climate change [हवामान बदल] are visible on the state's agriculture [शेती], and the scope of these effects is expected to widen in the future, as mentioned in the state's Climate Change [हवामान बदल] Action Plan for Agriculture [शेती]. Farmers in Marathwada and Vidarbha have been facing severe droughts for the past few years, which has adversely affected groundwater levels and soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. Consequently, the productivity of crops has declined. In this adverse situation, it has been observed that the production [उत्पादन] of smallholder farmers is adversely affected. The second phase of the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp has been initiated by the Government of Maharashtra with financial assistance from the World Bank with the objective of enabling farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].
The increased level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is an important factor associated with climate change [हवामान बदल]. The plantation of fruit [फळ] orchards (perennial trees) is very effective in the process of sequestering this carbon dioxide (Carbon Sequestration [कार्बन शोषण / कार्बन साठवण]). Along with the economic upliftment of farmers, sequestering the carbon dioxide that causes climate change [हवामान बदल] is an objective of this project.
1. Objectives
1.1. To expand climate-resilient farming practices [हवामान लवचिक शेती पध्दती] through the plantation of long-term income-generating fruit [फळ] crops.
1.2. To achieve the objective of increasing farmers' income by generating regular and maximum income from horticulture [उद्यानविद्या] plantation.

Make sure that the seed [बियाणे] is tested by PCR [पीसीआर] test and is free from important viruses. The stocking of L. vannamei prawn seeds is done at a rate of less than 20 per square meter in the low-density rearing method and at a rate of 20 to 60 per square meter in the highdensity method. The seed [बियाणे] selected in the hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] is put in a plastic bag filled with about one-third of water [पाणी] and the bag is inflated with oxygen and sealed airtight. The seed [बियाणे] is transported from the hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] to the farm [शेत] in such bags. Check the temperature [तापमान], pH and salinity [खारटपणा] of the water [पाणी] in such bags. Place a 500-1000 litre fibre tank on the bank of the pond [तलाव] and gently release the seed [बियाणे] and water [पाणी] from the bag into the tank. Remove the dirt accumulated at the bottom of the tank by the siphon method. Continuously supply oxygen or air to the tank. Then slowly take the water [पाणी] from the pond [तलाव] into the tank. Due to this, all the traits of sugarcane [ऊस] come as they are in the next generation. But along with the good qualities of this method, there are some disadvantages. - तण शेंडे (शूट टिप्स) व नव्हेले पाने काहीशी पांढुरकी होतात आणि मरतात;

- शेतातील ५–१० रोपांची तपासणी करून वरील लक्षणे पुन्हापुन्हा दिसत आहेत का, ते बघा;

NEWER TRACE ELEMENTS [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये]

 There are few trace elements [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] which are present in very low concentrations and their beneficial functions have been studied. Chromium (Cr) is known to influence glucose utilization and is termed as glucose tolerance factor. Practical diets of livestock [पशुधन] appear to contain enough Cr to meet the requirement inspite of its low availability from feed [खाद्य/चारा] stuffs. Supplementation of Cr as Cr-picolinate to ruminants has increased the feed efficiency [चारा कार्यक्षमता]. Boron [बोरॉन] (B) supplementation has shown to improve bone strength, increased Ca, Mg retention and semen [वीर्य] quality. Boron [बोरॉन] appears to have Vitamin D sparing action. Silicon (Si) is essential for growth [वाढ] and bone development in rats and chicks and believed to be associated with glycosamine and collagen synthesis. Induced Vanadium (V) deficiency in rats and chicks resulted in reduced feather growth [वाढ], iron [लोह] metabolism and impaired bone development. Further detailed research is required to confirm the essentiality and supplementary value of these newer trace elements [सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये].

CONCLUSIONS

 Minerals [खनिजे] play a significant role in production [उत्पादन] and reproduction either singly or in combination. Overcoming the deficiency or imbalance of the trace minerals [सूक्ष्म खनिज] improves the productive efficiency of livestock [पशुधन] to great extent. Hence minerals [खनिजे] are to be considered in tropical feeding [खाऊ घालणे] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] not in isolation [अलग ठेवणे] but as a part of total nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली]. In India, where land [जमीन] availability for grazing [चरणे] or fodder [चारा] cultivation is less and type of cultivar [वाण](grains [धान्ये], legumes, oil seeds) is designed mostly for human consumption, only the by-products are available to animals. Hence the emphasis should be on ways of mineral supplementation, cost-effectively based on prevailing livestock farming [पशुपालन] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] and available resources. Three forms of mineral supplements can be practically adopted. 1. General purpose, productivity supporting, inorganic mineral compounds 2. Special purpose (high phosphorus [स्फुरद], high calcium [कॅल्शियम], high zinc [झिंक]), which are area specific formulated depending upon valid area survey results. 3. Organic [सेंद्रिय] ligand bound specific supplements (chelates, proteinates, amino acid complexes) for feeding [खाऊ घालणे] under stressful / deficient conditions. Research on nano and encapsulated minerals [खनिजे] is still in its initial stages.

- अझोटोबॅक्टर नंतर पी.एस.बी. जोडून बियाण्याला लेप द्यावा.

**Sowing [पेरणी]:** Sowing [पेरणी] of rainfed wheat [गहू] should be done only if there is sufficient moisture in the soil [माती] and complete care should be taken to ensure that the seeds fall in the moisture. If there is not enough moisture in the soil [माती] at the time of irrigated sowing [पेरणी], irrigate and sow [मादी डुक्कर]. Keep a spacing [अंतर] of 20 cm between two rows for rainfed and timely irrigated sowing [पेरणी] and 18 cm spacing [अंतर] between two rows for late irrigated sowing [पेरणी]. Take care that the wheat [गहू] seeds do not fall more than 5 to 6 cm deep at the time of sowing [पेरणी].

**Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** Apply 40 kg nitrogen [नत्र] and 20 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] per hectare for rainfed cultivation at the time of sowing [पेरणी]. For irrigated timely sowing [पेरणी], apply 100 to 120 kg nitrogen [नत्र], 50 to 60 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] and 50 to 60 kg potash per hectare and for irrigated late sowing [पेरणी] apply 70 kg nitrogen [नत्र], 60 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] and 40 kg potash. For both irrigated timely and late sowings, half the dose [मात्रा] of nitrogen [नत्र] as well as the entire phosphorus [स्फुरद] and potash should be given at the time of sowing [पेरणी] and the remaining half dose [मात्रा] of nitrogen [नत्र] should be given at the time of the first irrigation [सिंचन] (after 18 to 20 days). If the water [पाणी] supply is limited, apply 60 kg nitrogen [नत्र] and 30 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] per hectare along with sowing [पेरणी].

**Note:**

1. Apply potash and micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] as needed after soil testing [माती परीक्षण].

**Method of Using Bacterial Cultures and Fungicides [बुरशीनाशके]:**

2. Prepare a solution of 125 grams of jaggery [गूळ] in one liter of warm water [पाणी].
3. After the above solution has cooled, add 200 to 250 grams of bacterial culture in a sufficient amount of it.
4. Spread 10 to 12 kg of seeds in a thin layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] on a clean floor, plastic, or tarpaulin and sprinkle the prepared culture mixture on it.
5. Then rub the seeds with a light [प्रकाश] hand.
6. First treat the seeds with a fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] and then apply a mixture of nitrogen [नत्र]-providing (Azotobacter or Rhizobium [रायझोबियम]) + phosphorus [स्फुरद]-solubilizing (P. S. B.) to the seeds.
7. Dry [कोरडे] the treated seeds in the shade.
8. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the treated seeds within 24 hours after treatment [उपचार].

### **Precautions to be Taken While Applying Bacterial Culture:**

1. Keep the bacterial culture packet in a cool and dry [कोरडे] place, away from insecticides [कीटकनाशके], fungicides [बुरशीनाशके], germicides, and chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते].
2. Use the bacterial fertilizer [खत] by the expiry date given on the bacterial culture packet.
3. Before applying Rhizobium [रायझोबियम] bacteria [जीवाणू], first treat all pulses with fungicides [बुरशीनाशके] and then sow [मादी डुक्कर] by applying bacterial culture.

5. Do not mix bacterial culture with any chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत].
6. The bacterial culture of each crop [पीक] is different. The bacterial culture of the crop [पीक] should be used for the same crop [पीक].
7. Seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] should be done in the shade and after drying [वाळवणे] such seeds in the shade before sowing [पेरणी], sowing [पेरणी] should be done immediately.

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
Source: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (MPKV), राहुरी
```
1. Sulphur [गंधक]

Sulphur [गंधक] is used for improvement of the chalked alkaline soil [अल्कधर्मी माती / क्षारयुक्त जमीन]. By reaction of water [पाणी] and oxygen from air Sulphur [गंधक] generates Sulphuric acids these sulfuric acid’s make a reactions with lime [चुना] in the soil [माती] and produce Calcium [कॅल्शियम] sulphate (Gypsum [जिप्सम]). Chalk + Sulphur [गंधक] + Acid = Gypsum [जिप्सम] + Water [पाणी] + Carbon di-oxide. With generated gypsum [जिप्सम]’s calcium [कॅल्शियम] creates a relations with soil [माती] sodium then Sodium Sulphate generated. Because Sodium Sulphate is soluble in water [पाणी], gets leeched out with water [पाणी] and the level of sodium reduces in the soils, so the soil [माती] become more workable and physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती] improved and good. In chalked alkaline soil [अल्कधर्मी माती / क्षारयुक्त जमीन] with soil testing [माती परीक्षण], 1/5th the content of gypsum [जिप्सम] can be mixed with FYM and used as soil amendment [मृदा सुधारणा].

**C. Soil Management [मृदा व्यवस्थापन]**

1. **Land Leveling [जमीन सपाटीकरण / जमीन समतलीकरण]:**

Leveling is essential for uneven or steeply sloping land [जमीन]. On unevenly levelled fields, water [पाणी] either doesn't reach the elevated areas or reaches in reduced quantities, while it accumulates in excess in low-lying areas. If there is an excessive slope, water [पाणी] applied through canals or wells runs off in the direction of the slope, and less water [पाणी] is available for irrigation [सिंचन]. In saline soils and soils with a high water table [पाण्याची पातळी], waterlogging [पाणी साठणे / पाणी साचणे] should be avoided. Rainwater should also be directed in channels in the direction of the slope. Therefore, a slope of 0.05 to 0.25% is satisfactory for heavy soils, 0.20 to 0.40% for medium soils, and 0.25 to 0.35% for light [प्रकाश], sandy soils.

1. **Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:**

To reduce the salinity [खारटपणा] of the soil [माती] and to prevent the water table [पाण्याची पातळी] from rising after the reclamation of saline soils [क्षारयुक्त मृदेची पुनर्बांधणी], excessive use of water [पाणी] should be minimized. Effective techniques such as drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] should be used. Drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] allows for the efficient use of brackish or saline groundwater. If the water quality [पाण्याची गुणवत्ता], salt [मीठ] level, and soluble salt [मीठ] content are up to 2000 milligrams/liter or 3.12 decisiemens/meter, the water [पाणी] can be used for drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. A 20% overlap of wetted area is necessary to maintain a constant moisture content [आर्द्रता] near the dripper outlet. The concentration of salts in the brackish water [खारट पाणी] is thereby reduced. Therefore, planting the crop [पीक] near the dripper is beneficial.

**Measures for Vegetable Crops in Drought [दुष्काळ] Conditions**

In drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, good market prices are obtained for vegetable crops and farmers get good benefits as vegetable cultivation is very limited due to adverse climate [हवामान] (high temperature [तापमान] and dry [कोरडे] hot air) and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता]. For this, it is important to select the right vegetable crop [पीक] and get quality production [उत्पादन] from it. It is difficult to grow vegetable crops in drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, but some measures can be taken to use less water [पाणी], e.g. to cultivate some vegetables by using drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन]. Some important measures for this are as follows.

1. Selecting vegetable crops that require less water [पाणी] e.g. drumstick, hadga, guar and leafy vegetables.
2. Use of soil [माती] cover.
3. Onion [कांदा] Nursery [रोपवाटिका] Management [व्यवस्थापन].

- Onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] nursery [रोपवाटिका] should be prepared on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] should be done before sowing [पेरणी] onion [कांदा] seeds.
- Do not use too much chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Water [पाणी] the nursery [रोपवाटिका] before sowing [पेरणी] the seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly and then use a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] or rain gun.
- Use shed [निवारा] net on the nursery [रोपवाटिका] if possible.

1. To protect against dry [कोरडे] and hot winds, drumstick crop [पीक] or dense planting of maize [मका] should be done on all four sides of the field [शेत] or around the wind [वारा].

3. **Management [व्यवस्थापन] of Saline Water [खारं पाणी]:** Generally, water [पाणी] in the soil [माती] is found to be saline to a large extent in low rainfall areas. Highly saline water [खारं पाणी] contains more dissolved chloride and sulfate salts of sodium and magnesium. If wells in that area have saline water [खारं पाणी], the adverse effects of water [पाणी] can be avoided by using some specific management [व्यवस्थापन] methods. If saline water [खारं पाणी] is to be used for irrigation [सिंचन], it is necessary to easily remove it from the soil [माती] layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी]. The saline water [खारं पाणी] can be used for irrigation [सिंचन] in sandy loam or thick loam soils without any adverse effects. Good growth [वाढ] of crops can be achieved by limited but frequent watering to sandy loam soils. Also, if sprinkling [पाण्याचा फवारणी] is done instead of watering on the surface of the soil [माती], fewer salts accumulate in the soil [माती]. If the amount of boron [बोरॉन] in saline water [खारं पाणी] is high and the amount of sodium carbonate is up to 600 mg per liter, the crops grow well without any harm if 20 tons of gypsum [जिप्सम] per hectare is added to the soil [माती] and then saline water [खारं पाणी] is used for irrigation [सिंचन]. Also, if green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत] is used in the soil [माती] along with gypsum [जिप्सम], it is very useful. If the salt [मीठ] in the saline water [खारं पाणी] is moderate, then such water [पाणी] can be used for irrigation [सिंचन] by using farmyard manure [शेणखत] in the soil [माती]. It is appropriate to select those crops which can tolerate the salinity [खारटपणा] in the water [पाणी] while using saline water [खारं पाणी] for irrigation [सिंचन], e.g. Cotton [कापूस], Safflower [करडई], Bajra [बाजरी], Sorghum [ज्वारी] and Wheat [गहू].

While constructing greenhouses using plastic film covering, the following points should be considered:

**1\. Greenhouse [हरितगृह] Direction:** If a single-span greenhouse [हरितगृह] is to be built, the direction should be East-West so that it helps to get the maximum amount of sunlight. But when building a greenhouse [हरितगृह] with more than one span, the direction should be North-South. This helps to ensure that the shadows of the plants do not fall on each other at any time of the day and that plenty of sunlight is available for 12 months.

**2\. Greenhouse [हरितगृह] Construction:** To increase the durability of the greenhouse [हरितगृह], using iron [लोह] pipes or square pipes instead of wooden or bamboo [बांबू] frames can make the frame last for at least 25 to 30 years.

**3\. Use of Roof:** The general slope of the roof should be 20 to 27 degrees to allow proper sunlight to enter and to prevent water [पाणी] droplets accumulated on the inside of the film in the greenhouse [हरितगृह] from falling directly on the crop [पीक] but instead sliding down the inner walls and falling on the ground.

**4\. Plastic Strip:** Before covering the frame with UV resistant film, wrap a plastic film strip around the frame or attach foam strips or thin wooden strips to the frame first. सर्व पानांवर माशी (पांढरी माशी) नियंत्रणासाठी सुरुवातीला शेतात नैसर्गिक शत्रू वाचवणे आणि नियमित पाण्याची फवारणी करणे उपयोगी ठरते, आणि प्रादुर्भाव जास्त झाल्यास शिफारस केलेल्या कीटकनाशकांची पानांवरील फवारणी करा.

**नैसर्गिक/जैविक उपाय:**
- क्रायसोपा, मॅलडा, इन्कार्सीआ, षील्ड बग यासारखे नैसर्गिक शत्रू शेतात वाचवा आणि रोज पाण्याची फवारणी पिकावर करून माशीचे प्रमाण कमी ठेवा
- किंवा पीक सापळ्यांतून आणलेल्या सूक्ष्मघटकाचा वापर — आय.सी.ए.आर. तयारीनुसार **इसरिया फ्युमोसोरॉसेआ** ५ मि./ली. पाणी किंवा टॅल्क तयारी ५ ग्र./ली. पाणी, कीड दिसल्यानंतर १५ दिवसांच्या अंतराने दोन—तीन फवारण्या

**रासायनिक फवारणी:**
- भेंडी: **फ्लुपिरॅडीफ्युरोन २०० एस.एल.** २० मि./१० लि. पाणी, आर्थिक उंबरठा पातळी गाठल्यावर एकदा आणि १० दिवसांनी दुसरी फवारणी
- कापूस: **फ्लॉनिकॅमिड ५०% डब्ल्यू.जी.** २ ग्र./१० लि. पाणी, कीड दिसल्यानंतर १५ दिवसांच्या अंतराने तीन फवारण्या; किंवा बीटी कापूसवर जर तुडतुडे व पांढरी माशी आर्थिक पातळी गाठली तर **डायफेन्थ्युरॉन ५० डब्ल्यू.पी.** १२ ग्र. किंवा **अॅसेटॅमिप्रिड २० एस.पी.** २ ग्र./१० लि. पाणी (दुसरी फवारणी आवश्यक असल्यास १५—२० दिवसांनी); किंवा १०५ दिवसानंतर **ट्रायझोफॉस ४०% ई.सी.** २० मि./१० लि. पाणी

**सुरक्षा:** रासायनिक फवारणी दरम्यान हातमोजे, मास्क आणि चष्मा वापरा आणि फवारणीनंतर लगेच खालील भागावर काहीही खाऊ नका.

**स्रोत: डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**; **भारतीय कृषी संशोधन परिषद (ICAR)** जैव कीटकनाशके**; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (MPKV), राहुरी** 

तुम्ही कोणत्या पिकावर ही माशी जास्त प्रमाणात बघता — रोपवाटिका आहे का किंवा मुख्य शेतात?

results.question: शेती यंत्रांसाठी एटीएमए योजनेत अनुदान कसे मिळेल?
results.answer:
शेती यंत्र व उपकरणांसाठी राज्य व केंद्राच्या **कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण** योजनेतच अनुदान देण्याची तरतूद आहे, आणि या योजनेत "अ‍ॅ.टी.एम.इ." या नावाने स्वतंत्र योजना दस्तऐवजामध्ये सापडली नाही.

---

**राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण – शेती यंत्र/उपकरण लाभ** (राज्य)
- शेतकऱ्यांना ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, तसेच ट्रॅक्टर चालित, पीक संरक्षण आणि काढणीनंतरचे प्रथम प्रक्रिया यंत्र/उपकरण खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक मदत मिळते.
- सामान्यपणे अनुदान दर: अ‍ॅस., एस्‌टी. व लहान शेतकरी, महिलांसाठी ४०%; इतर शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ५०% किंवा केंद्र सरकारने जाहीर केलेला कमाल मर्यादा हद्द, यातील कोणतीही लहान रक्कम लागू होते.

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी

**अर्जासाठी आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- खरेदी करावयाच्या यंत्राचा कोटेशन
- यंत्राचा चाचणी अहवाल
- ट्रॅक्टर चालित यंत्रासाठी ट्रॅक्टरचे आर.सी.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- अर्ज महाडीबीटी या पोर्टलवर करता येतो; लाभदार निवड व अनुदान वितरण पूर्णपणे ऑनलाईन डब्ल्यू.बी.टी. पद्धतीने होत असल्याचे उल्लेख आहे.

---

**प्रधानमंत्री कृषि यांत्रिकीकरण** (केंद्र)
- ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, ट्रॅक्टर चालित, पीक संरक्षण व काढणीनंतरचे प्रथम प्रक्रिया यंत्र/उपकरण खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक मदत.
- सामान्यपणे अनुदान दर: अ‍ॅस., एस्‌टी. व लहान शेतकरी, महिलांसाठी ४०%; इतर शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ५०% किंवा केंद्राची कमाल मर्यादा हद्द, यातील लहान रक्कम लागू.

**पात्रता:**
- वैयक्तिक शेतकरी

**कागदपत्रे:**
- यंत्राचा कोटेशन
- चाचणी अहवाल
- ट्रॅक्टर चालित यंत्रासाठी ट्रॅक्टरचे आर.सी.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर अर्ज करता येतो; डब्ल्यू.बी.टी. पद्धतीने अनुदान जमा केले जाते असे नमूद आहे.

---

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण ज्या विशिष्ट यंत्रासाठी अनुदान घ्यायचे आहे ते नेमके कोणते आहे? (उदा. ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, फवारणी यंत्र, धान्य शुद्धीकरण यंत्र)

results.question: गाय मध्ये मस्टायटिस (कासदाह) साठी काय उपचार आहेत?
results.answer:
गायमध्ये कासदाह (मस्टायटिस/स्तनदाह) आला तर लगेच पशुवैद्याचा सल्ला घ्या — वेळेवर उपचार केल्यास बरे होण्याची शक्यता वाढते आणि उशीर झाला तर कासाचा नुकसान किंवा गाय मरू शकते.

**पहिली मदत:**
- आजच्याच दिवशी जवळचा पशुवैद्य निश्चित करा; संदेशात अपलोड आयडी असेल तर त्यानुसार फोटोवरून कीट/रोग विश्लेषणही करता येते, परंतु उपचारासाठी पशुवैद्याची आवश्यकता आहे.
- दूध पूर्ण काढणे म्हणजे संक्रमित दूध बाहेर काढणे हे उपचाराचे भाग ठरते (फक्त वैद्यकीय मार्गदर्शनाखाली).

**उपचार प्रकार (पशुवैद्य निश्चित करतील):**
- थनामध्ये प्रतिजैविक औषधे टाकणे (कासमध्ये इंटरनेल्डिंग)
- दर्द कमी करणारे/प्रतिज्वार औषधी इन्जेक्शन
- गरजेनुसार दूर प्रथिनी/सिस्टमिक प्रतिजैविक उपचार (काही रोगांच्या स्थितीत)

**इतर महत्त्वाचे नियम:**
- उपचारानंतर किमान ४ दिवस त्या गायचे दूध टाकून द्या किंवा पशुवैद्यांनी सांगितल्यानुसार पाळा.
- आजारी गाय सुरक्षित पशूंपासून वेगळी ठेवा; स्वच्छ व कोरडे शेड राखणे हा सर्वात महत्त्वाचा मुद्दा आहे.
- जुनी, हार्ड लंप किंवा ऊतक कठीण असलेली कायमस्वरूपी संसर्ग अवस्था असेल तर पशुवैद्यांचा सल्ला तसाच महत्त्वाचा आहे.

**स्रोत: हायनडबुक ऑफ गुड डेअरी हसबंद्री प्रॅक्टिसेस (एन.डी.डी.बी.); पशुसंवर्धन व दुग्धव्यवसाय विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन**

आजारी गाईला कोणती लक्षणे दिसत आहेत—कासात सूज, ताप, किंवा दूधात बदल—यापैकी कुठले आहेत?

- CMT Equal quantities of milk [दूध] and CMT reagent are mixed by rotating, SCM milk [दूध] will form a gel. CMT reaction may disappear within 20 seconds , readings must therefore be taken fast. Also check each quarter separately.
- CMT may give false positive reaction in very early (less than 10 days) lactation or when animal is almost dry [कोरडे].
- Strip cup test Small flakes are present in SCM milk [दूध] when viewed against a black surface, size of flakes increase with the degree of SCM.
- Paper test Green colour is indicative of SCM.
- Field [शेत] mastitis [स्तनदाह] test Can be carried out like CMT using using concentrated detergent solution instead of CMT reagent.

**Recent Advances in Diagnosis and Control of Livestock Diseases**

```
1.3. Preventative Measures

Prevention [प्रतिबंध] of mastitis [स्तनदाह] is as important as treatment [उपचार], and several strategies have been implemented to reduce the incidence of the disease [रोग]:

 Selective Dry Cow Therapy [ड्राय काऊ थेरपी] (SDCT): In traditional blanket dry cow therapy [ड्राय काऊ थेरपी], all cows were treated with antibiotics at the end of their lactation period. However, SDCT has become a more targeted approach, where only cows with a high somatic cell count [सोमॅटिक पेशी संख्या] (SCC), a history of mastitis [स्तनदाह], or positive culture results are treated with antibiotics. This method reduces the overall use of antibiotics and minimizes the risk of antimicrobial resistance [प्रतिकारशक्ती] (AMR). All cows receive a teat [थन] sealant to block bacterial entry during the dry [कोरडे] period.

 Vaccines: Vaccination [लसीकरण] is another emerging strategy in mastitis [स्तनदाह] control [नियंत्रण]. Vaccines against common mastitis [स्तनदाह] pathogens, such as Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, and Mycoplasma [मायकोप्लाझ्मा] bovis, are being developed and used to reduce the severity of infections and prevent chronic mastitis [स्तनदाह]. There are some of the commercial vaccines available viz. EnviracoreTM J5, J-VAC ,STARTVAC - TOPVAC , Polyvalent inactivated vaccine , BOVILIS J-5 etc . Besides these vaccines and some experimental vaccines have shown promise in controlling infections and reducing the need for antibiotic [प्रतिजैविक] treatments.

 Milking [दूध काढणे] Practices and Equipment Maintenance: Proper milking machine [दूध काढण्याचे यंत्र] maintenance, teat [थन] disinfection, and good hygiene [स्वच्छता] practices during milking [दूध काढणे] play an essential role in preventing mastitis [स्तनदाह]. Pre- and post-milking [दूध काढणे] teat [थन] disinfection removes potential contaminants, and milking [दूध काढणे] machines should be properly calibrated to avoid injury to the teats. Additionally, ensuring clean bedding [गादी], proper barn ventilation [हवेची आदळ], and minimizing animal stress can help reduce the risk of mastitis [स्तनदाह].
```

```
Control [नियंत्रण]

- 1. Identification, isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and treatment [उपचार] of affected dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] animals.
- 2. Regular testing of dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cows for mastitis [स्तनदाह]
- 3. Treatment [उपचार] of all teats of all cows/ buffaloes at drying [वाळवणे].
- 4. The healthy non-infected cows should be milked first and known infected cows should be milked at last.
- 5. The udder [कास] of cow [गाय] and hands of milker should be washed with antiseptic solution [जीवाणू नाशक द्रावण] before and after milking [दूध काढणे].
- 6. Unsterile objects should not be passed in teat [थन].

- 7. Teat [थन] sores/ wounds should not be neglected but treated at promptly.
- 8. Use of proper milking [दूध काढणे] method i.e. full hand milking [दूध काढणे] followed by stripping.
- 9. Maintain hygienic conditions in cattle [गाय वर्ग] shed [निवारा] /milking [दूध काढणे] parlour .
- 10. The non-responsive quarter should be permanently dried up.
- 11. Culling of non-responsive cases.

8.2.2 Viral diseases

(1) Foot-and-Mouth Disease [रोग] (FMD)

Synonyms: Apthous fever [ताप], *Khurkut*

It is highly contagious [संसर्गजन्य] viral disease [विषाणूजन्य रोग] of cloven footed animals viz. cattle [गाय वर्ग], buffalo [म्हैस], sheep [मेंढी], goat [शेळी] and pigs.

Do you know ?

Crossbreds and young cattle [गाय वर्ग] are severely affected and are more susceptible for FMD.

In India, the disease [रोग] is causing heavy economic loss due to reduction of milk [दूध], meat [मांस] and working capability of draft animals. The disease [रोग] outbreaks usually occurs at the end of winter i.e. in February and March.

Causative agent

- 1. It is caused by virus namely *Picorna virus* (Apthovirus)
- 2. There are 7 major strains of the virus namely O, A, C, Asia-1, SAT-1, SAT- 2 and SAT- 3.

2. The Importance of Antibiotic [प्रतिजैविक] Susceptibility Testing (AST)

Antibiotic [प्रतिजैविक] resistance [प्रतिकारशक्ती] has become a major concern in veterinary medicine [पशुवैद्यकीय औषधोपचार], particularly with the overuse and misuse of antibiotics in dairy farming [दुग्धव्यवसाय]. Mastitis [स्तनदाह] treatment [उपचार] often involves the use of antibiotics, but the indiscriminate use of these drugs can lead to the development of resistant strains of bacteria [जीवाणू]. AST plays a critical role in ensuring that cows receive the right antibiotic [प्रतिजैविक] treatment [उपचार], thus preventing the spread of resistance [प्रतिकारशक्ती].

2.1. Understanding Antibiotic [प्रतिजैविक] Susceptibility Testing (AST)

AST is a laboratory test that determines the effectiveness of different antibiotics against a particular bacterial pathogen [रोगजनक]. By testing the bacterial isolate obtained from a mastitisinfected cow [गाय]'s milk [दूध], AST can help identify which antibiotics are effective and which are not. This information is essential for selecting the appropriate treatment [उपचार] regimen, ensuring that cows receive the most effective therapy.
```

results.question: भुईमुगावरील टिक्का रोगासाठी प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय काय आहेत?
results.answer:
भुईमूगावरील टिक्का रोग हा बुरशीजन्य रोग असल्याने, प्रतिबंधात्मक उपायांमध्ये पेरणीपूर्वी बियाणे प्रक्रिया, योग्य वेळेत लागवड आणि रोगप्रतिकारक वाण निवड या महत्त्वाचे आहे.

**बियाणे प्रक्रिया:**  
पेरणीपूर्वी बीला थायरम किंवा कॅप्टन २.५ ग्राम प्रति १ कि.ग्रा. बी प्रमाणे प्रक्रिया करा.  
**लागवडीचा कालावधी/पद्धत बदल:**  
ज्या हंगामात टिक्का जास्त येतो तिथे लागवडीच्या पद्धती किंवा तासदी बदलण्याचा पर्याय असावा (उदा. काही ठिकाणी थेंब करपा टाळण्यासाठी नोव्हेंबर–डिसेंबरमध्ये लागवड); तुमच्या जिल्ह्यातील सल्ला स्थानिक अधिकाऱ्याकडे घ्या.  
**रोगप्रतिकारक वाण निवड:**  
टिक्का, गंज आणि मुळखोड जोड कुज यांसारख्या बुरशीजन्य रोगांच्या संदर्भात गुजरात भुईमुग ३७ आणि गुजरात भुईमुग ३८ हे वाण प्रतिकारक्षम दिसतात; उपलब्ध वाण स्थानिक कृषी विज्ञान केंद्रातून तपासा.  
**जैविक उपाय:**  
टीका, गंज इत्यादी बुरशीजन्य रोगांपासून संरक्षणासाठी भुईमूग पिकात ट्रायकोडर्मा विरिडे जैविक कीटकनाशकाचा वापर शिफारसीनुसार करता येतो.

हे सर्व प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय केल्यानंतरसुद्धा लक्षणे दिसली तर लगेच नियंत्रणाच्या पायऱ्या लागू होतात, पण प्रतिबंधासाठी वरील पायऱ्या ठरवून करा.

**स्रोत: क्रुषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; भारतीय कृषी संशोधन परिषद (आई.सी.ए.आर.), नवी दिल्ली**

results.answer:
ऊसावरील तांबेरा (गंज रोग) हा पानावर उभ्या ओळीमध्ये लहान-लहान राखाडी/तांबूस डाग अथवा धबधबीत वाटणाऱ्या गोलकडयांप्रमाणे दिसतो, आणि हे लक्षणे दिसल्यानंतर फार वेळ न घालवता त्वरित बुरशीनाशकाची फवारणी केल्यास नियंत्रण होते.

**लक्षणे:**
- पानावर राखाडी ते तांबूस रंगाचे छोटे छोटे डाग किंवा धबधबीत गोलकडया उभ्या ओळीत दिसणे.
- सुरुवातीचे हे लक्षणे आलेच की पुढील दिवसांत पानांवरील गंज अधिक प्रकर्षात येतो.

**प्रतिबंध:**
- जमिनीवर सेंद्रिय कार्बन सुधारण्यासाठी आच्छादन व तण नियंत्रण व्यवस्थित ठेवा (म्हणजे हवेने पसरणाऱ्या रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी राहतो).
- लागवडीपूर्वी जमीन तयारी उत्तम करा.

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण:**
- **१ फवारणी (मुख्य):** रोगाचे सुरुवातीचे लक्षणे दिसल्यावर ७ दिवसांनी **अॅझॉक्सिस्ट्रोबिन १८.०% + डिफेनकोनाझोल ११.४% एस.सी.** हे संयुक्त बुरशीनाशक **०.१%** (१ मि.ली. प्रति लिटर पाणी) या प्रमाणात फवारणी करा.

results.question: रोपवाटिकेतील 'रोप कोलमडणे' (Damping Off) साठी घरगुती उपाय काय आहेत?
results.answer:
रोपवाटिकेत रोप कोलमडणे हा जमिनीतील बुरशीमुळे होणारा रोग आहे, ज्यामध्ये गाठीने लागवड, पाण्याचा कमी निचरा आणि पावसाळा यामुळे रोपे पिवळसर व निस्तेज होऊन जमिनीला लागलेले खोड कुजून सगळे रोपे कोलमडतात.

**लक्षणे:** रोपे निस्तेज-पिवळसर दिसणे आणि जमिनीला लागलेले खोड कुजून रोपे कोसळणे.

**प्रतिबंध:** रोपांची गर्दी कमी ठेवणे, चांगला पाण्याचा निचरा सुनिश्चित करणे; बी उगवण्यापूर्वी योग्य बीज प्रक्रिया करणे (दस्तऐवजांनुसार बुरशीजन्य संरक्षणासाठी).

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण:** मिरची/टोमॅटो/कोबी यांसाठी रोप कोलमडणे (रोप सड) येत असल्यास दस्तऐवज दिल्यानुसार खालील बुरशीनाशकांपैकी एखादे वापरण्याचा पर्याय देत आहे:
- **कॅप्टन ७५% डब्ल्यू.पी.:** २.५ ग्राम प्रति लीटर पाणी (फवारणी)
- **कार्बेन्डाझिम ७५% डब्ल्यू.पी.:** २ ग्राम प्रति लीटर पाणी (फवारणी)
- **मेन्कोझेब ७५% डब्ल्यू.पी.:** ३ ग्राम प्रति लीटर पाणी (फवारणी)
- **मेटलाक्सिल-एम ३१.८% ई.एस.:** २ मि.ली प्रति लीटर पाणी (फवारणी)

**घरगुती उपायांबद्दल माहिती:** सध्याच्या उपलब्ध कृषी दस्तऐवजांत रोपवाटिकेतील रोप कोलमडणे साठी घरगुती/नैसर्गिक उपायांचा स्पष्ट उल्लेख सापडला नाही.

**फायदे:**
- पपईच्या दोन ओळींच्या फरशांच्या (सोडवलेल्या जमिनीच्या) दोन्ही बाजूंना आच्छादन करता येते; यामुळे मातीचा ओलावा संवर्धन, जल मुरणे (पाण्याची झिरपण्याची क्षमता) वाढ, आणि रोपांच्या मुळांभोवती मृदा तापमान नियंत्रण मिळते.
- कोरडे पाने व सेंद्रिय अवशेष आच्छादन करून धूप प्रतिबंध, वाहून जाणारे पाणी कमी होणे, मृदा संरचना सुधार आणि तण वाढ नियंत्रण लाभतात; याशिवाय पाऊसावर कठीण कोरडा थर (कर्सट) तयार होणे टाळले जाते.
- सेंद्रिय भागाचे विघटन झाल्यावर पोषकांची उपलब्धता वाढते आणि जलबद्धतेमुळे आर्द्रता स्थिती चांगली राहते, त्यामुळे सिंचनातील अंतर वाढवता येते.
- काही निरीक्षणांनुसार आच्छादनाने पीकाचे पाण्याचे प्रमाण २० ते ३०% ने कमी होते, हवेचे आवरण/वाहाण मातीत राहते आणि तणांची लक्षणे कमी होतात; काळ्या प्लास्टिक आच्छादनासाठी उत्पादन १२ ते ४८% ने वाढ आणि पाणी बचत सुमारे २०% अशी नोंद आहे, तसेच ठिबक सिंचन सोबत आच्छादानाची वापर केल्यास अतिरिक्त पाणी बचत सुमारे १०% होते अशी सूचना दस्तऐवजात आहे.

**करावं:**
- कोरड्या किंवा सेंद्रिय अवशेषांनी आच्छादन करा, किंवा हंगामानुसार आंतरपीक घेतले तर त्याचा सजीव आच्छादन (लाइव्ह मल्च) चा वापर होतो; तण आले तर तो उपराडून तिथेच ठेवल्याने देखील त्याचा सेंद्रिय आच्छादन उपयोग होतो अशी शिफारस आहे.

3.8 Mulching [आच्छादन]

Mulching [आच्छादन] involves covering the soil [माती] surface with live crops or straw (dead plant [रोप/वनस्पती] biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ]) (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.7). It is a very important technique with multifaceted benefits such as moisture conservation [ओलावा संवर्धन], increased water infiltration [पाणी मुरणे / पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता], soil temperature regulation [मृदा तापमान नियंत्रण] around plant [रोप/वनस्पती] roots, erosion [धूप/झीज] prevention [प्रतिबंध], soil structure improvement [मृदा संरचना सुधार], runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] reduction, and weed [तण] growth [वाढ] control [नियंत्रण]. It also prevents the formation of a hard crust after rain. It creates a 'dust mulch [आच्छादन]' on the soil [माती] surface using blade harrows or intercultural operations [आंतरमशागत क्रिया]. This breaks the continuity of soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] capillary tubes, reducing evaporation losses. The applications of this are usually in high-rainfall regions to minimise soil [माती] and water [पाणी] loss and in low-rainfall areas to conserve soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा]. The different types of mulch [आच्छादन] are discussed below.

Fig [अंजीर]. 3.7: Mulching [आच्छादन]

3.8.1 Crop Residue Mulch [पीक अवशेष आच्छादन]

The materials required for this type of mulching [आच्छादन] are dried vegetation, farm [शेत] stubble [खुंट], and dried biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] waste (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.8). It protects the soil [माती] by covering and shielding it from severe sunlight, cold, and rain. It also provides seed [बियाणे] protection by saving it from birds, insects, and animals. Thereby, it conserves moisture and enhances soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता], along with protecting soil [माती] organisms and supporting their growth [वाढ]. Crop residue mulch [पीक अवशेष आच्छादन] suppresses weed [तण] growth [वाढ] and also maintains soil temperature [मृद तापमान].

**How to Start Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]?**

In organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], not only annual crops [वार्षिक पिके] are considered, but also various useful, perennial tree crops, fruit [फळ] crops, and other diverse production [उत्पादन] chains complementary to agriculture [शेती] are considered. Substances discarded by one production [उत्पादन] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] should be used for another system [पद्धत/प्रणाली]. In these complementary businesses, it is necessary to select animal husbandry [पशुसंवर्धन], poultry farming [कुक्कुट पालन], pisciculture, beekeeping [मधमाशी पालन], vermiculture [गांडूळ खत निर्मिती], mushroom production [उत्पादन], etc., and make them compatible with the local situation.

Generally, it is intended to have forest farming [शेती करणे] on 1/3 of the total area, cash crops on 1/3 of the area, and food grain [धान्य] crops on the remaining 1/3 of the area. However, some changes can be made in this considering the type, size, and water [पाणी] availability of the soil [माती] on the available area. First of all, it is necessary to do the bunding of the land [जमीन] as well as leveling wherever necessary. Then, forest walls should be erected by planting multipurpose tree crops on the boundaries of the field [शेत] on all sides. For this, it is necessary to creatively use neem [कडूलिंब], teak [टिक], Glyricidia, Shevri [शेवरी], Drumstick, Hadga, Aapta, Ber [बोरफळ], Mango [आंबा], Custard apple [सीताफळ], Bamboo [बांबू], etc. This not only fulfills all the local needs of the farmer [शेतकरी] but also achieves biodiversity [जैवविविधता] on the farmland. Since all these types of trees bear flowers and fruits in various seasons throughout the year, a conducive environment is created for the habitat of birds, honeybees, and other parasitic insects. Soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is stopped, and soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] is helped to be retained in the farmland. Nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] from the lower layers are drawn up and deposited in the upper layers in the form of leaf [पान] fall, which helps in increasing fertility [प्रजननक्षमता]. Organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] mulching [आच्छादन] increases organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] and biodiversity [जैवविविधता] in the soil [माती]. Weed control [तण नियंत्रण] is done. Evaporation of water [पाणी] from the soil [माती] surface is prevented. The soil temperature [मृद तापमान] is kept favorable in summer as well as in winter. Accumulation of salts on the surface is prevented. The number and diversity of earthworms and bacteria [जीवाणू] are increased. With so many benefits, the production [उत्पादन] level in agriculture [शेती] increases and helps in maintaining continuity.

### **Use of Mulch [आच्छादन] in Orchards and Vegetable Gardens**

Just as different colored mulches are beneficial to different crops, so are the woven plastic mulches particularly beneficial to crops. Mulching [आच्छादन] helps to cover the surface of the soil [माती] near the trees in the field [शेत]. This helps in saving water [पाणी] and increasing production [उत्पादन]. The crop [पीक]'s water [पाणी] requirement is reduced by 20 to 30 percent, the air remains circulating in the soil [माती], and the incidence of weeds [तण] is reduced. Research has shown that black plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन] increases production [उत्पादन] by 12 to 48 percent depending on the crop [पीक], saves about 20 percent of water [पाणी], and weed control [तण नियंत्रण] averages 80-90 percent. Germination [अंकुरण] of crops like chilli [मिरची / मिर्ची] is 4 to 6 days earlier due to black plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन]. With mulching [आच्छादन] in drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], there has been a significant increase in the production [उत्पादन] of various crops by 10 to 80 percent, as well as an additional savings of 10 percent of water [पाणी].

**Various types of Mulch [आच्छादन]:**

1. **Organic [सेंद्रिय] Mulches:** This includes stubble [खुंट], straw, dry [कोरडे] grass, husk [भुसा] and straw, leaf [पान] litter [कचरा].
2. **Inorganic Mulches:** This includes various plastic mulches. E.g. Chandni, black, white, blue, yellow red sky and transparent colored plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन], etc. It has been observed that using red mulch [आच्छादन] for tomato [टोमॅटो] crop [पीक] and light [प्रकाश] blue and white mulch [आच्छादन] for potato [बटाटा] crop [पीक] significantly increases production [उत्पादन].

No-Till Cultivation Technology [तंत्रज्ञान] for Rabi Crops [रब्बी पिके] in Konkan

No-till cultivation means planting the crop [पीक] by digging the soil [माती] just enough for sowing [पेरणी] without any special cultivation. However, in this method, weed control [तण नियंत्रण], seed sowing [बियाणे पेरणी] and fertilizer application [खत वापर / खत देणे] are essential. Using such methods for crop [पीक] cultivation has the following advantages [फायदे].

- 1. The available moisture in the soil [माती] lasts longer.
- 2. The cost of cultivation [लागवडीचा खर्च] is reduced. This increases net profit [नफा].
- 3. The infestation of weeds [तण] is reduced.
- 4. Less labour is required. This saves on input costs.

- 5. Since moisture is retained in the soil [माती], crops like pulses can be taken on such residual moisture [अवशिष्ट ओलावा / अवशिष्ट आर्द्रता].
- 6. If crops are to be taken under irrigation [सिंचन], 50 per cent of water [पाणी] is saved.
- 7. Water [पाणी] saving increases the area under irrigation [सिंचन].
- 8. Sowing [पेरणी] can be done on time as the cultivation time is saved.
- 9. Germination [अंकुरण] is good as the seeds get plenty of moisture.

Selection of Crops for No-Till Cultivation: For this type of cultivation, select crops that require less water [पाणी]. In addition, select crops that are planted by making furrows. The following crops are mainly included in this. Pulse [डाळ] Crops: Wal, cowpea [चवळी], horse gram [कुलथी / हुलगा], soybean [सोयाबीन], mung bean. Oilseed [तेलबिया] Crops: Mustard [मोहरी], niger seed [बियाणे], sesame [तीळ], sunflower [सूर्यफूल / सुर्यफुल] etc. Vegetable Crops: Bottle gourd [दुधी / दुधी भोपळा], bitter gourd [कारले], French bean, watermelon [टरबूज], cucumber [काकडी] etc.

Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण] in Previous Crop [पीक]: To control [नियंत्रण] the weeds [तण] in the previous crop [पीक], spray Paraquat Gramoxone 24 S.L. this non-selective contact herbicide [संपर्क तणनाशक] 6 to 7 ml per liter of water [पाणी]. Spray the herbicide [तणनाशक] 4-5 days before sowing [पेरणी].

9.2.3 Preservation of meat [मांस]

 The primary objective is to inhibit microbial spoilage and arrest physio-chemical process which brings about deterioration in quality. Methods used for preservation are as follows

1. Refrigeration : Meat [मांस] can be stored at 10 to 40 C with relative humidity [सापेक्ष आर्द्रता] of 80-85% for about a week. Crushed ice or mechanical refrigeration are generally used for chilling or cold storage [शीतगृह].

2. Freezing : Meat [मांस] can be frozen in air or liquid or refrigerated plates. Ideally, only chilled carcasses should be frozen.

a. Slow freezing : Still air, the method generally used in home freezer or small freezing operation.

b. Quick [नखाचा रक्तवाहिनी असलेला भाग] freezing : Air blast [करपा] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] used in commercial operation. Meat [मांस] stored at -200 C for 12, 15, 18 months with excellent, good and satisfactory quality, respectively.

3. Curing and smoking : These are closely interrelated and often practiced together. Curing is the process of salting meat [मांस] along with one or more of the glutamates, ascorbic acid, acetic acid and phosphate. Cured chicken are smoked in a smoke chamber maintained at 40- 450 C and 30-35% relative humidity [सापेक्ष आर्द्रता] for about 4 hours. The smoking process imparts a characteristic flavour and stable colour to the cured product and helps in preservation. Cured chicken could be stored for 4 and 14 days at ambient (260 C) and refrigeration (4-50 C) temperature [तापमान], respectively while cured and smoked chicken for 14 and 30 days under the corresponding storage conditions [साठवणूक मापदंड].

Climate [हवामान]: Betel vine requires cool shade, necessary humidity [आर्द्रता] in the air and constant moisture in the soil [माती]. This crop [पीक] grows in areas with annual rainfall of 40 cm to 75 cm. Humidity [आर्द्रता] needs to be between 60 and 70%. Dry [कोरडे] and hot climate [हवामान], strong winds and extreme cold are not suitable for this crop [पीक].  
Soil [माती]: Select fertile soil [माती] with excellent drainage. Betel vine should not be planted in black soil [काळी मृदा] or in soil [माती] that does not drain water [पाणी]. It is beneficial to take a green crop [पीक] before planting.  
Pre-cultivation: 3-4 deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] vertically and horizontally, cultivation, making the soil [माती] friable. After planning, plant [रोप/वनस्पती] Shevri [शेवरी], Drumstick or Hadga plants in June or July for shade and support to Betel vine.

Epidemiology

Host affected

**अंबिया बहार:** फळांची काढणी साधारणतः सप्टेंबरच्या दुसऱ्या पंधरवड्यापासून नोव्हेंबर अखेरपर्यंत झालेली आहे.
**मृग बहार:** फळांची काढणी फेब्रुवारीपासून एप्रिल पर्यंत झालेली आहे.

या काढणीच्या कालावधीवरून तुम्ही तुमची बहार व्यवस्थापन योजना ठरवू शकता; तरी नेहमी पाण्याचा ताण होऊ देऊ नका आणि आखाडा ओलिता करायचा असल्यास गरजेनुसार तुषार सिंचन वापरा असे मार्गदर्शन उपलब्ध आहे.

**6\. Fruit [फळ] Sucking Moth:** During the ripening of citrus fruits, the moths of this pest [कीड] puncture the fruits at night and suck the sap inside. Pathogens enter through these punctures, causing the fruit [फळ] to rot [कुजणे/सड] around the puncture. As a result, the infested fruits fall off. This pest [कीड] is more common on _Ambia_ flush fruits (September-October) than on _Mrig_ flush fruits.

**Control [नियंत्रण]:** To reduce the incidence of this pest [कीड], collect and destroy the fallen fruits under citrus trees. Destroy weeds [तण] such as Gulvel, Vasanvel, Chandvel, etc., around the citrus orchard. Use light [प्रकाश] traps [सापळे] (7 to 11 pm). Smoke in the orchard in the evening, and as soon as the infestation is visible, spray 5% neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] extract (500 grams/10 liters of water [पाणी]) or neem oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] 100 ml mixed in 10 liters of water [पाणी]. Collect rotten fruits in the orchard and bury them in pits, and keep the orchard clean.

**7\. Mite:** For the management [व्यवस्थापन] of red mites [अळ्या] on citrus, spray Dicofol 18.5% SC at 27 ml mixed in 10 liters of water [पाणी], as recommended by the Central Insecticides [कीटकनाशके] Board under label claim. The first spray should be done at the fruit [फळ] development stage and the second spray after one month. Also, to manage mites [अळ्या] on citrus and to maintain good quality of citrus fruits, spray 5% neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] extract twice at an interval of one month.

**8\. Yellow Mealybug [पिठ्या ढेकूण]:** For the control [नियंत्रण] of this pest [कीड], spray _Verticillium lecanii_ 1.15% WP (1 x 108 CFU/gram [हरभरा]) at 50 grams/10 liters of water [पाणी]. If necessary, spray a second time after 15 days.

**9\. Scale Insects:** For the control [नियंत्रण] of this pest [कीड], spray Quinalphos 25 EC 56 to 84 ml/10 liters of water [पाणी].

results.question: हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर करून जमिनीचा पोत कसा सुधारावा?
results.answer:
हिरवळीच्या खताने जमिनीचा पोत सुधारण्यासाठी सर्वांत महत्त्वाची गोष्ट म्हणजे योग्य वेळेस हिरवळीचे पीक शेतामध्ये गाडणे आणि सेंद्रिय पदार्थ वाढविणे.

**माती तयारी:** पावसाळा सुरु होऊन गेरपुष्प किंवा चारपाट पिकांना (उदा. गेलिक्रिडीया, ढैंचा, टॅग) लगेच लागवड करा. कापणीपूर्वी एकदा खोल नांगरणी केल्याने मातीतील हवा प्रवाह आणि पाणी मुरणे सुधारते.  

**जाती/पीके:** गेलिक्रिडीया, ढैंचा, टॅग ही हिरवळीची खतपिके आहेत; भात लागवडीआधी किंवा पडीक जमिनीवर यांचा वापर करा.

Crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट] is the practice of growing different types of crops in succession on the same field [शेत] to gain benefits for soil [माती] and crop [पीक] systems (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.2). The advantages [फायदे] of including legumes include reduced soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप], restored fertility [प्रजननक्षमता], improved soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन], and nitrogen [नत्र] supplementation through nitrogen fixation [नायट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण].

4.1 Introduction

Soil [माती] is a fundamental resource for food production [उत्पादन] and a crucial asset for farmers. The success of farming [शेती करणे] relies on soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता], as it supplies water [पाणी] and vital nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to crops. When soil [माती] is rich and healthy, combined with adequate water [पाणी] and sunlight, it supports productive farming [शेती करणे] and helps achieve desired yields. Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] treats soil [माती] as a living, multifunctional system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], where soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], or humus [ह्युमस], serves as a critical reservoir supporting nutrient [पोषक घटक] retention, water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता], and soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना] (FAO, 2015). Incorporating farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] significantly enhances microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] and diversity, thereby increasing soil [माती] resilience and nutrient cycling [अन्नद्रव्य चक्र / पोषण चक्र] through the activation of indigenous microbes (Semenov et al., 2021). Long-term use of organic [सेंद्रिय] amendments (e.g., FYM applied at 15 t/ha) markedly increases soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], dissolved organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], and key nutrient [पोषक घटक] pools under pearl milletwheat rotations (Sheoran et al., 2025). Soil pH [मातीचा सामू / मृदा सामू], a key determinant of nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], can be effectively managed using natural amendments: lime [चुना] in highly acidic soils-and manure [खत] or straw in moderately acidic soils-not only raise pH by 12-17%, but also improve cation exchange capacity [धनायन विनिमय / कॅटायन विनिमय क्षमता], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and crop yield [पीक उत्पादन] (Zhang et al., 2023). A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs.

Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. ICARNAARM field [शेत] studies under Zero Budget Natural Farming [शून्य खर्च नैसर्गिक शेती] in Andhra Pradesh recorded an increase of 821% in soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], 1327% higher microbial biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon, and significantly higher soil [माती] enzymatic activity compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] systems. Similarly, long-term NF trials in soybeanmaize and wheatmustard systems reported 1.31.8 times higher populations of beneficial soil microbes [मृदा सूक्ष्मजीव] and improved soil aggregation [मातीचे एकत्रीकरण] and moisture retention [ओलावा टिकवून धरणे] under Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] practices.17

```
b) Green Manures

Green manures provide organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] to the soil [माती] which increases the efficiency of the bacteria [जीवाणू] in the soil [माती] thereby leading to a radical improvement in the physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and chemical properties of the soil [माती]. The types of green manures and the amount of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] and organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] supplied to the soil [माती] are given in the following table.

Research conducted by the university has shown that applying 10 tons of *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* leaves per hectare yields as much rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] as the recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] (100 kg N + 50 kg P + 50 kg K).

*Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* seedlings or cuttings [कापणी टप्पे] should be planted on the bunds of the field [शेत] or fallow land [पडीक जमीन] at the beginning of the monsoon [पावसाळा] season [हंगाम/ऋतू]. As *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* grows rapidly at the beginning of the monsoon [पावसाळा], plenty of *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* leaves will be available at the time of rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] of rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ]. Generally, the leaves of 4 to 6 trees are enough for one Guntha (approximately 100 square meters). The leaves should be buried in the soil [माती] during puddling [चिखलणी] before rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] of rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ]. *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* leaves contain 2.75 per cent nitrogen [नत्र], 0.5 per cent phosphorus [स्फुरद], and 1.15 per cent potassium [पालाश]. Care and management [व्यवस्थापन] of calf [वासरू]:

It includes removing mucus, cutting naval cord 2.5 cm from naval region, allow calf [वासरू] to suckle colostrums within an hour of birth and continue for 3 days, feeding [खाऊ घालणे] of calf starter [वासरासाठी प्रारंभिक आहार] after one month of age, green fodder [हिरवा चारा] after 4 months of birth, deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] calf [वासरू] with in 7-10 days and weaning at 4-8 week after birth .Commercial colostrum can be given(bovine haemoglobin, cheese whey [व्हे] or colostrum from immunized cow [गाय] ). Other management [व्यवस्थापन] practices include disbudding [अनावश्यक कळ्या काढणे], ear tagging and castration are important for care and management [व्यवस्थापन] of calf [वासरू].

Care and management [व्यवस्थापन] of milch animals:

This include supply of green fodder [हिरवा चारा], extra concentrate of 1 kg for every 2 to 2.5 kg of milk [दूध], and training [प्रशिक्षण] cow [गाय] to let down milk [दूध] without calf [वासरू] suckling. The other management [व्यवस्थापन] practices include regular exercise [नियमित व्यायाम] for keeping animal fit, grooming [खरारा करणे] for animal coat clean, glossy hair, stimulate urination and clean milk production [स्वच्छ दूध उत्पादन]; care in holding, control [नियंत्रण] of bad habits , manure [खत] disposal and bedding [गादी] materials, isolation [अलग ठेवणे] of sick animals, insuring animals, and disposal of carcass are essential for improvement of animal's productivity.

results.question: जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवण्यासाठी सेंद्रिय मार्ग सुचवा.
results.answer:
जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवायचा तर मशागत किमान ठेवा, जमीन-पाणी संवर्धन करा, पिकांच्या अवशेषांपैकी एक तृतीयांश जळवायला न देता मातीत भरून टाका आणि नियमित शेणखत/कंपोस्ट/गांडूळखत यासारख्या खालच्या खतांची भर द्या.

**मशागत व माती संरक्षण:**  
- नांगरणी अनेक वेळा करणे कमी करा; जमिनीची समतोलन (लेवलिंग) करून धूप होणे टाळा.
- जमिनीवर ऊसाचा ट्रॅश किंवा गव्हाचे काडंबरे असलेल्या आच्छादनाचा वापर करा.

**पिकांचे अवशेष:**  
- पेरणीपूर्वी किंवा हंगामानंतर पीक अवशेषांपैकी एक तृतीयांश भाग जळवू नका; ते जमिनीत बुडवा.
- ते लवकर कुजू शकेल म्हणून ट्रायकोडर्मा बुरशीचा वापर जमिनीत करण्यास सुचविण्यात आला आहे.

**सेंद्रिय खते:**  
- शेणखत, कंपोस्ट, गांडूळखत हे खालच्या प्रमाणे नियमितपणे वापरा.

It has come to light [प्रकाश] after some surveys that the incidence of cancer is increasing due to crops taken through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] and pesticides. To curb all these types, it has become very essential and necessary to carry out organic [सेंद्रिय] and chemical residue free farming [शेती करणे].

**Management [व्यवस्थापन] of Organic Carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन]:** Organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] is related to the physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती] and it works to balance and control [नियंत्रण] the properties of the soil [माती]. Due to the increase in the availability of proper amount of air and water [पाणी] in the soil [माती] due to organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], the number of bacteria [जीवाणू] in the soil [माती] increases and the efficiency of the bacteria [जीवाणू] increases. The supply of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] can be balanced by organic [सेंद्रिय] substances. Organic [सेंद्रिय] substances include bulky fertilizers used for agriculture [शेती] like cow dung [शेण] manure [खत], compost [कंपोस्ट] fertilizer [खत], poultry manure [कोंबडी खत], goat [शेळी]-sheep [मेंढी] manure [खत], wheat [गहू] straw, safflower [करडई] straw, crop [पीक] residues, green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत] etc. The amount of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] in total organic [सेंद्रिय] substances is up to 50 to 58 percent after decomposition. Organic [सेंद्रिय] substances not only improve the physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती] but also increase the biological properties, which definitely increases the availability and efficiency of plant [रोप/वनस्पती] nutrients [पोषक तत्वे].

results.question: What is the treatment for Milk Fever in buffaloes?
results.answer:
दुधाचा ताप (मिल्क फिव्हर/हायपोकॅल्शिया) हा व्यानेच्यावेळी रक्तातील कॅल्शियमाचे अचानक घटल्यामुळे येणारा चयापचयी विकार आहे, त्यामुळे उपचार म्हणून प्राणवाहिनीतून कॅल्शियम द्रावण देणे गरजेचे असते.

**लक्षणे:**
- गाय-बैलांची खोड पोट्यावर राहणे, उठणे कठीण होणे आणि अशक्तपणा जाणवणे.

**प्रतिबंध:**

जन्मलेल्या नवीन वासरूंना कृमिनाशक देण्याची पहिली मात्रा जन्मानंतर अगदी सुरुवातीच्या आठवड्यातच द्यावी, आणि पुढे नियमितपणे ठराविक अंतराने कृमिनाशक देत राहावे.

**सुरुवात:** वासरू जन्माला आल्यावर पहिल्या आठवड्यात एक वेळ कृमिनाशकाची शिफारस आहे; काही सूचनांमध्ये तिसऱ्या दिवशी/सातवा ते दहावा दिवस असेही दिलेले आहेत.
**प्रथम दोन महिन्यांच्या आधीचे (इतर सूचना):** काही मार्गदर्शिकांतून एका महिन्यानंतरपासून मासिक कृमिनाशक असे सुद्धा सांगितलेले आहे.
**सहा महिन्यांपर्यंतचा प्लॅन:** पहिल्या सहा महिन्यांसाठी दर महिन्याला कृमिनाशक देणे आवश्यक मानले आहे.
**याशिवाय:** काही सूचनांनुसार पाऊस हंगामात अंतर ३५ ते ४० दिवस ठेवावे असेही दिले आहे.
**नियंत्रणाची चिन्हे:** अतिसार, वजन घट होणे, माती चावणे, मंद वाढ, दुर्बलता यांसारखी लक्षणे कृमिजन्य संसर्गात दिसू शकतात.

कृपया आपण कोणत्या गाव/तालुक्यात असल्यास सांगा, कारण स्थानिक पशुवैद्यकांच्या मार्गदर्शनेनुसार कृमिनाशकाची निवड, योग्य प्रमाण आणि अचूक अंतर हे ठरते.

Therefore, control [नियंत्रण] of ecto- parasites during that season [हंगाम/ऋतू] is important. - Young animals (up to 18 months) should be dewormed more frequently (at least 4 times in a year and if necessary monthly) than adult animals depending on the climate [हवामान] and management [व्यवस्थापन]. - Routine use of the same anthelminthic drugs should be avoided to prevent build-up of resistance [प्रतिकारशक्ती]. - Correct dosage should be used to prevent formation of resistance [प्रतिकारशक्ती]. 27 MANUAL ON MANAGEMENT [व्यवस्थापन] OF GAUSHALAS Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] schedule - Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be started from the first week of calf [वासरू]. - A single oral dose [मात्रा] of 10 g piperazine adepate/ albendazole is recommended for the calves preferably in the first week of life to control [नियंत्रण] neonatal ascariasis. - Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be done every month for first six months, thereafter once in three months. ``` ---- **Animal Science and Technology Standard XII** Source: शिक्षण विभाग, महाराष्ट्र ``` Table 1.6 : Vaccination schedule [लसीकरण वेळापत्रक] for cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes 1.16 Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] - Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] is the process of removal of endoparasites such as roundworms, tapeworms and liver flukes. - Anthelmintic are used for deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] purpose.
